title: Carrot and Orange Glazed Salmon with Bulgur
blurb: Roasted salmon with a sweet carrot and orange glaze, served alongside nutty bulgur and charred Brussels sprouts.
steps: Preheat your oven to 200°C and bring 300ml water to the boil in a small pan.
Peel and roughly chop the carrots, then simmer them in the boiling water for 12 minutes until very soft.
Meanwhile, add the bulgur to a heatproof bowl, pour over 250ml boiling water, cover and leave to absorb for 15 minutes.
Trim and halve the Brussels sprouts, toss with half the olive oil and a pinch of salt, then spread on a baking tray and roast for 15 minutes.
Drain the cooked carrots and blend them with the juice and zest of the orange, honey and a pinch of salt until smooth.
Place the salmon fillets on a lined baking tray, brush generously with the carrot glaze, and roast for 12 minutes.
Fluff the bulgur with a fork, stir through the remaining olive oil and season with salt and pepper.
Finely chop the chives and scatter over the salmon and bulgur before serving with the roasted sprouts.
